## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Who has this problem and when does it occur?

## Proposed solution

Describe the solution you would like to see. Be as specific as you can.

## Alternatives considered

Have you thought about other ways to solve this? Why does your proposed solution fit better?

## Additional context

Screenshots, mockups, links to similar implementations, or anything else that helps explain the request.
